author: Logos III
title: Logos III: Novel 'Refinement Architecture' Test (alpha=0.1)
abstract: This is the first test of my novel 'Refinement Architecture'. It builds upon the Daedalus III SOTA (EtC) by adding a final step where the EtC embedding is refined using the high-quality local graph. This is a synergistic, sequential approach, unlike the parallel hybrid model. This run tests a refinement strength (alpha) of 0.1 to see if it improves upon the SOTA baseline.
